questions.question: If 19 July 2000 is Wednesday, then what will be the day of the week on 17 March 2015?
questions.solution:
Given: **19 July 2000** was Wednesday.

Now,

2000 to 2015 = 15 Years (12 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 12 Ordinary Years have 12 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 12 = 18.

18 odd days → 18/7 = 2 weeks and 4 odd days.

then, 19 July 2015 will be Wednesday + 4 = Sunday.

Now, the number of days between 17 March 2015 to 19 July 2015

= 14(March) + 30(Apr) + 31(May) + 30(June) + 19(July) = 124 days.

= 124 days → 124/7 = 17 weeks and 5 odd days.

So, **17 March 2015** will be Sunday - 5 = Tuesday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".

questions.question:
In this question, three statements are given, followed by three conclusions numbered I, II and III. Assuming the statements to be true, even if they seem to be at variance with commonly known facts, decide which of the conclusion(s) logically follows/follow from the statements.

**Statements:**

Some carrots are onions.

All onions are potatoes.

All potatoes are radish.

**Conclusions:**

I. Some carrots are radish.

II. All onions are radish.

III. No carrot is a potato.

options.text: Both conclusions I and II follow.

questions.solution:
The least possible Venn diagram for the given statements is as shown below :

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/7846150d88c05fba4cba6d246c9986fa0ef4c05e197729f841c9193d23873668.png] 

Conclusions:

I. Some carrots are radish → Follow (As some carrots are onions, all onions are potatoes and all potatoes are radish. As some part of carrots is common with onions which whole comes in potatoes which whole comes in radish, therefore some carrots are radish is true.)

II. All onions are radish → Follow (As all onions are potatoes and all potatoes are radish. As some part of carrots is common with onions which whole comes in potatoes which whole comes in radish, therefore all onions are radish is true.)

III. No carrot is a potato → Does not follow (As some carrots are onions and all onions are potatoes. As no direct relation is given between carrot and potato, therefore no carrot is potato is false.)

∴ Here, Both conclusions I and II follow.​

Hence, the correct answer is "**Both conclusions I and II follow**"

questions.question: If 10 October 2003 was a Friday, then what was the day of the week on 8 October 2015?
questions.solution:
Given: **10 October 2003** was Friday.

Now,

2003 to 2015 = 12 Years (9 Ordinary Years and 3 Leap Years).

And, In 12 Years = 3 Leap years and 9 Ordinary Years.

So, 3 Leap Years have 6 odd days,

And, 9 Ordinary Years have 9 odd days.

Total odd days = 6 + 9 = 15.

15 odd days → 15/7 = 2 weeks and 1 odd day.

Then, 10 October 2015 will be Friday + 1 = Saturday.

Now, the number of days between 10 October 2015 to 8 October 2015

= 2 days.

So, **8 October 2015** will be Saturday - 2 = Thursday.

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 1".

questions.question:
This question consists of a pair of words which have a certain relationship to each other. Select the pair which does NOT have the same relationship.

Allure : Repulse

1) Creation : Destruction

2) Fluctuate : Stabilize

3) Immense : Huge

4) Notion : Reality
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: **Opposites**.

Here,

Allure : Repulse → **Allure** is the opposite of **Repulse**.

Similarly,

Creation : Destruction → **Creation** is the opposite of **Destruction**.

Fluctuate : Stabilize → **Fluctuate** is the opposite of **Stabilize**.

Notion : Reality → **Notion** is the opposite of **Reality**.

However,

Immense : Huge → **Immense** is not the opposite of **Huge**; they are synonyms.

Hence, the correct answer is **"Option 2"**.

questions.question:
Select the set in which the numbers are related in the same way as are the numbers of the following sets.

(NOTE: Operations should be performed on the whole numbers, without breaking down the numbers into its constituent digits. E.g., 13 – Operations on 13 such as adding /deleting /multiplying etc. to 13 can be performed. Breaking down 13 into 1 and 3 and then performing mathematical operations on 1 and 3 is not allowed.)

(4, 16, 32)

(7, 49, 98)
questions.solution:
The logic followed here is:

Logic: (1st number)² = 2nd number; 2nd number × 2 = 3rd number.

Now,

For, (4, 16, 32)

⇒ 4² = 16;

⇒ 16 × 2 = 32.

For, (7, 49, 98)

⇒ 7² = 49;

⇒ 49 × 2 = 98.

Similarly, for **(12, 144, 288) **

**⇒ 122 = 144;**

**⇒ 144 × 2 = 288.**

Hence, the correct answer is "Option 2".
